about: A first use case per stage, written as the outcome an engagement would deliver. Used to name suggested starting points; the ranking itself is computed from findings.

prod::Downtime.title: Trusted OEE and downtime reporting
prod::Downtime.outcome: One downtime number every report agrees on, with an agreed rule for changeovers and planned maintenance.

prod::Production Reporting.title: Trusted OEE and downtime reporting
prod::Production Reporting.outcome: Morning numbers that tie out across the MES, the shift log and the reports, with no hand-built totals.

prod::Quality.title: One scrap and yield number
prod::Quality.outcome: Scrap, rework and yield defined once and counted the same way in every system.

prod::Work Order.title: Clean job and work order data
prod::Work Order.outcome: Every shift record joins to a work order, so cost, schedule and OEE can be traced job by job.

o2c::Shipping.title: On-time delivery you can defend
o2c::Shipping.outcome: One definition of on time, measured from the same dates in every report.

o2c::Fulfillment.title: A past-due backlog everyone believes
o2c::Fulfillment.outcome: Backlog and fill rate built from the same order and shipment records.

o2c::Sales Order.title: Bookings from one source
o2c::Sales Order.outcome: Orders counted once, with clear rules for changes and cancellations.

cost::Standard Cost.title: Margin on real costs
cost::Standard Cost.outcome: Scrap and downtime priced from agreed standard costs and rates.

ap::Receiving.title: Supplier on-time delivery
ap::Receiving.outcome: Receipts matched to purchase orders with one rule for what counts as on time.

gl::Reporting.title: Cost of quality in the books
gl::Reporting.outcome: Quality costs flowing from the floor into reporting under one definition.

gl::Budget.title: Targets you can plan from
gl::Budget.outcome: One budget and one current forecast, with targets and attainment all measured against the same ones.

gl::Periods.title: One working calendar
gl::Periods.outcome: Every daily and weekly figure spread over the same working days, shifts and hours.
